evt_ai_ml_workshop.name: AI & Machine Learning Workshop
evt_ai_ml_workshop.venue: KCT Campus - Ramanujan Block Mech Lab 2
evt_ai_ml_workshop.description: Hands-on intensive workshop focusing on real-world Deep Learning pipelines, PyTorch architecture, Neural Network optimization, and Generative AI deployment.
evt_ai_ml_workshop.rules:
1. Participants must bring their own laptops.
2. EventHub Digital QR Code must be shown at the entrance.

evt_codesprint.name: CodeSprint 24-Hour Hackathon
evt_codesprint.venue: KCT Tech Park - C-DAC Innovation Lab
evt_codesprint.description: Annual flagship coding marathon challenging student teams to innovate solutions for Smart Coimbatore, Sustainable Mobility, and Campus Automation.
evt_codesprint.rules:
1. Maximum 4 members per team.
2. QR Check-in opens at 07:30 AM sharp at C-DAC entrance.

evt_cloud_computing.name: Cloud Computing & DevOps Bootcamp
evt_cloud_computing.description: Master Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, and CI/CD automated deployment pipelines with AWS cloud credits provided for attendees.
evt_cloud_computing.rules:
1. Basic knowledge of Linux command line is recommended.
2. Show your EventHub QR code at the seminar hall registration desk.

evt_tech_symposium.name: KCT Tech Symposium 2026
evt_tech_symposium.description: The premier student technical congregation bringing together guest keynotes, paper presentations, and robotics showcases.
evt_tech_symposium.rules:
1. Open to all departments and year levels.
2. Formal college dress code and valid KCT ID card along with EventHub QR pass required.
